8/S0.subgoal: Outline the scope of the lecture by introducing the issues and challenges in virtual and augmented reality systems.

8/S1.subgoal: Recall the definition and state the main objective of a Virtual Reality system.

8/S2.subgoal: Identify the two major challenges in VR: technological and psychological.

8/S3.subgoal: Define immersion and identify the six qualitative terms that characterize a VR experience.

8/S4.subgoal: Describe the six qualities (extensive, matching, surrounding, vivid, interactive, and plot informing) that contribute to immersion.

8/S5.subgoal: Explain how immersion represents the technological issue in creating a VR experience.

8/S6.subgoal: Define presence as a subjective psychological state experienced by the user in VR.

8/S7.subgoal: Compare and contrast immersion (objective) and presence (subjective), explaining how they relate to one another.

8/S8.subgoal: Explain why the overall goal of any VR system is to achieve a high degree of presence.

8/S9.subgoal: Preview the subsequent lectures, indicating that immersion and presence are not the only issues facing VR systems.
